audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagreed between layers. phases[0].side read Ekko while the sentence under it said "your passive-stacked autos win level 1". Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 read Skill in full against Orianna/Ekko/Orianna in content, and row 4 read Ekko in full against Skill in content — while content's own whys[4] said "Chronobreak at 6 makes his all-in low-risk and gives him the kill window".
audit.why: Levels 1-3 are Orianna's: Timewinder costs 50-90 mana a throw and Parallel Convergence needs seconds to form before it can stun. Level 6 is his — Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1 but only 50s at rank 3, and it refunds a failed dive. At 2+ items he has to land inside your team and Command: Shockwave answers the landing.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Orianna, phases[3] stays Skill, phases[4] stays Ekko with content win[4] flipped from Skill to Ekko to match it and to match content's own whys[4], phases[5].side = Ekko, phases[6].side = Orianna — every flipped row's why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named no Ekko spike and carried an unsourced magnitude ("Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar").
audit.why: Ekko's spike is not an item, it is Chronobreak's rank curve: 110s at rank 1 down to 50s at rank 3. Nothing else in the game moves that far.
audit.corrected: Spike line rebuilt on the Chronobreak cooldown curve.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text promises Command: Shockwave catches his dive "before he can rewind".
audit.why: Command: Shockwave launches enemies after a short delay, and Chronobreak makes Ekko untargetable while it resolves — the delay is exactly what the untargetability window is for. The honest version is to spend the ult while the rewind is on cooldown, not to race it.
audit.corrected: The delay-versus-untargetability trade is now stated, with the instruction to ult once the rewind is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] calls Ekko's kit melee and whys[0]/early call his poke "clunky".
audit.why: Timewinder reaches 1075 against Command: Attack's 815 — he out-ranges Orianna's poke. What he cannot do cheaply is repeat it: the Q costs 50 mana at rank 1 rising to 90. Phase Dive is the melee part, at 325 range. "Clunky" is also a hedge that tells the reader nothing.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real early-game brake — his mana and the 325-range dash he has to walk in to use.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears nowhere on the page, and report[8].t tells an Orianna facing Ekko to "buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6".
audit.why: Chronobreak heals Ekko for a percentage of the damage he received during the rewind window, so Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended fight — this is the needs-antiheal interaction flagged in _missing for this matchup. The Zed reference is a template leak naming a champion who is not in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal added to the item line, tied to Chronobreak by name, and the stopwatch timing pointed at Ekko.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells the reader what Ekko's combo looks like before it lands.
audit.why: Phase Dive is an auto-attack reset: he rolls first, and the teleport comes on the next attack. The roll is the cue to step back — by the time the teleport resolves the decision is already made. Flagged as autoreset-burst-tell in _missing.
audit.corrected: "the roll is the tell, not the teleport" written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit, and the packet reports zero sequencing cues across the whole matchup.
audit.why: Chronobreak 110/80/50, Timewinder 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Parallel Convergence 22/20/18/16/14, Phase Dive 9/8.5/8/7.5/7; Command: Protect 9s, Command: Shockwave 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, report[9].t and the do's/don'ts, each with a concrete wait-for-X instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were all pasted from elsewhere — two of them the tradeGood/tradeBad strings — under titles they do not explain.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed: "Slow-field his exit path mid-dive" was explained with a ball-placement trade rule.
audit.corrected: Each body rewritten to answer its own title.

notes: Two things the page had backwards. First, it treated Ekko as a short-range champion who pokes clumsily — Timewinder is 1075 range against Command: Attack's 815, so he out-ranges you; the real early brake is his mana (50 rising to 90 per Q) and the 325-range Phase Dive he has to walk in to use. Second, spikes[3].text promised Shockwave beats the rewind: Command: Shockwave resolves after a short delay and Chronobreak grants untargetability, so racing it is the losing plan and spending the ult during its downtime is the winning one. report[8].t contained a template leak naming Zed in an Ekko matchup — replaced, and anti-heal added there and in breakdown.feeding since Chronobreak's heal is the needs-antiheal interaction flagged in _missing. Chart handled the same way as the diana matchup: content win[4] flipped from Skill to Ekko so it agrees with phases[4].side and with content's own whys[4], which already described level 6 as his kill window. Left alone: content.late (its claim about catching him before the rewind is achievable if the ult is timed on downtime, which the spikes edit now explains), breakdown.mid, breakdown.late and breakdown.wave (Orianna-generic, nothing Ekko-specific fit the length band).
